profile.headline: Senior Web Application Developer
profile.summary: Senior enterprise web application developer, architect, and manager of web applications, committed to quality, customer value, and team-based success. Experience in all aspects of the software development life cycle since 1995. Subject matter expert in energy efficiency and carbon footprint assessments.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Senior developer in Cornell IT’s Custom Development group, building websites and web applications for the Cornell community with Drupal and Laravel. Core developer of Cornell’s COVID testing and health management web application, integrating community-facing tools with back end systems such as institutional research, student information, HR, building access, residential life, and Salesforce.

positions.title: Senior Web Application Developer
positions.description: Member of the team designing and developing the integrated web applications of Ithaca College. Technical lead for the redevelopment of the Ithaca College website and infrastructure.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description: I taught Introduction to Website Development (Comp 105), a course on the fundamentals of building websites from scratch with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Chief Architect
positions.description: Software architecture team lead responsible for enterprise web applications and technical direction. Lead for software specifications. Client representative and subject matter expert for residential energy efficiency programs. Business analysis for key projects. Legacy product programming support.

positions.title: VP for Software Development
positions.description: Oversight of all software and web applications. Design of software architecture and implementation planning. Management of 10-person development staff using Scrum/XP agile approach. Client project specifications and project management. Coordination of software maintenance and upgrades. Guided rearchitecture of core web application product that is now the primary focus of the 50-person business. Customer portal web site development.

positions.title: President
positions.description: Small business management and development. Web site development and programming, including web applications and content management systems. Project management. Client relationship management. Technical management of web hosting for 100+ sites. Hiring and supervision of staff and subcontractors. Cultivated a specialty in carbon footprint calculators for high profile clients. Acquired by Performance Systems Development and its investors as continuation of six year enterprise web application project.

positions.title: Director of Software Development
positions.description: Management of staff, resources, and communication for software development projects. Management and production of software projects. Software project planning, interface design, content development, formal testing, and product release. System administration for web site hosting. Research and education in renewable energy, energy efficiency, and green development.
